The '''DL-68 Cutting Blaster''' was a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[cutting blaster]], designed for use by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and explorers. It produced a "cold blast" of energy, which was a prolonged burst of low-powered cohesive light capable of cutting down a tree. The "cold blast" was not strong enough to throw up sparks or start a fire during its use, but required a great deal of power.<ref name="GG8" />
